body:
Thank you all for attending today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9706):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Panos Astithas, Mason Freed, Vladimir Levin, Olli Pettay, David Baron, Keith Cirkel, Artur Iunusov, Brian Kardell, Noam Rosenthal, Khushal Sagar

1. Review past action items
    1. Marcos will find someone from WebKit to provide feedback on the [Proposal: fire an event before the first rendering opportunity after activation](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9315). 
        1. Still pending.
    1. Vladimir will comment on the proposal above with an example of a rAF-based solution.
        1. Done.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. None.
1. New topics
    1. [Khushal] [[View Transitions] Extend render-blocking to support Document](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9332)
        1. Olli will add a comment before TPAC, where we will discuss this further.
    1. [Anne] [Use inside settings to fetch the descendants of module worker in the worker module script graph](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9571)
        1. Anne was absent, carrying over to the next one.
    1. [Panos] [TPAC meeting](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/issues/284) next week, so let's skip the next triage in two weeks.
    1. [Mason] [[Proposal] Invoker Buttons - allowing popover/dialog and more to be invoked without JS](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9625)
        1. Discussed it at a high level, more detailed feedback to come next week.
    1. [Brian] [Update the :dir / directionality to include shadow dom](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9166)
        1. Brian will not have time for this in the near future, so if everyone else wants to jump in, please do.

### Action Items

1. @smaug---- will add a comment before TPAC to [[View Transitions] Extend render-blocking to support Document](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9332), where we will discuss this further.
